title: Ending a DIC Award: Remarriage, Death, Survivors Pension Election and Renunciation
content:
## The rule

A surviving spouse who remarries before the remarriage retention age loses Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) effective the last day of the month before the remarriage, and living with another person while holding out as spouses is treated as remarriage; a spouse who remarries at or after that age keeps DIC.

DIC can be resumed after a disqualifying remarriage ends by death or divorce.

The award also ends on the spouse's death or an election of Survivors Pension.

## Reasons a DIC award ends

A DIC award, whether its status is running or suspended, ends (status terminated) for one of these reasons:

| Reason | Basis |
|---|---|
| The surviving spouse's death | The award ends on the spouse's death |
| Remarriage before the remarriage retention age | Including living with another person while holding out as spouses; effective the last day of the month before the remarriage |
| An election of Survivors Pension | The award ends on that election |
| Renunciation | The award ends on the spouse's renunciation of DIC |

## Remarriage by age — condition, judgement, result

| Condition at the date of remarriage | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Spouse younger than the remarriage retention age | Disqualifying remarriage | DIC is lost from the last day of the month before the remarriage |
| Spouse at or above the remarriage retention age | Not disqualifying | DIC is kept |
| Spouse younger than the retention age begins living with another person, the two holding out as spouses | Treated as remarriage | As for a remarriage before the retention age |

## After a disqualifying remarriage ends

When the disqualifying remarriage ends, whether by death or by divorce, DIC can be resumed.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A surviving spouse below the remarriage retention age remarries on August 22. DIC ends effective July 31.
- A surviving spouse remarries on the day of reaching the remarriage retention age. The remarriage is at that age, and DIC is kept.
- A surviving spouse who lost DIC through a remarriage before the retention age later divorces. DIC can be resumed.
